display.label: Azure Storage File Share
display.description: Azure Storage File Share for SMB and NFS enterprise cloud file shares

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Storage File Share. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: File share name, target Storage Account, and storage quota.

fields.label: Share Name
fields.description: The name of the File Share. Must be 3-63 lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

validation.pattern_error: Share name must be between 3 and 63 characters, start and end with an alphanumeric character, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

fields.label: Storage Account
fields.description: The Azure Storage Account where this File Share should be created.

fields.label: Quota (GB)
fields.description: The maximum storage capacity allocated to this File Share in gigabytes.

sections.label: Share Settings & Protocol
sections.description: Access tier, protocol (SMB/NFS), and custom metadata.

fields.label: Access Tier
fields.description: The performance and cost tier for this File Share.

fields.label: Enabled Protocol
fields.description: Protocol used for file sharing. NFS is only supported on Premium storage accounts.

fields.label: Metadata
fields.description: Custom key-value metadata pairs for this file share.

sections.label: Access Control & Stored Policies
sections.description: ACL blocks and stored access policies for granular share permissions.

fields.label: Access Control List (ACL)
fields.description: List of stored access policies for the share.

fields.label: Policy Identifier
fields.description: Unique identifier for this stored access policy.

fields.label: Access Policy
fields.description: Permissions and validity window for this policy.

fields.label: Start Time
fields.description: Start time in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z).

fields.label: Expiry Time
fields.description: Expiry time in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g. 2027-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z).
